europe_now.title: Spanish Snap Elections and Housing Policy
europe_now.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is focusing heavily on housing initiatives as Spain faces a snap election following a rent crisis. The political maneuver aims to counter the surging influence of the far-right ahead of the upcoming national ballot.

sources.headline: Sánchez bets it all on housing ahead of Spain’s snap election
Spain’s 54-day sprint to the polls: can Sánchez’s housing gamble stop the far-right from entering into government?

europe_now.title: Escalating Student Demonstrations in France
europe_now.summary: High school protests in France have continued to trigger unrest and security challenges for the government. Student groups are predicting further escalations and larger demonstrations in the coming days.

sources.headline: French high school students predict escalation of protests
